people._note: Themes whose image text contains {person} get a random person on every run (never the same person twice in a row on a regenerate). Each group is picked with the given weight (out of the total), then a background from that group. Edit weights or backgrounds freely.

image_styles.A: Soft natural daylight, clean modern premium editorial photography feel, warm neutral palette with fresh teal and white accents, shallow depth of field, calm and elegant. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no before/after split images, no cartoonish or glowing teeth, no clinical or scary imagery. No festive, holiday or party styling, no decorations, no costumes.
image_styles.B: Bright, airy, natural lifestyle photography, crisp and clean, cooler daylight tones, fresh white and soft teal palette, candid unposed feel, slightly wider framing, gentle contrast. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no before/after split images, no cartoonish or glowing teeth, no clinical or scary imagery. No festive, holiday or party styling, no decorations, no costumes.

models._note: Cloudflare model for each image. Override with the IMAGE_MODEL_A / IMAGE_MODEL_B settings.
